routes.longName: This Express Service operates on the dates of all Dodger home games, departing from Harbor Gateway Transit Center Bay #9 and running up the Harbor Transitway to Dodger Stadium, beginning 2 Hours before game time and continuing until 45 minutes after the game ends. This is a free service to anyone with a ticket to the game.

routes.shortName: Downtown Inglewood Station -  Intuit Dome Express
routes.longName: The express shuttle will operate between Downtown Inglewood Station and Intuit Dome. Shuttle service will run every 20 minutes to the event, beginning roughly 2 hours before the event begins and run from the event every 10 minutes ending roughly 1 hour after the event concludes. Metro express service to Intuit Dome is FREE, but normal fares apply for regular Metro Bus and Rail service and parking fees at Metro Park & Ride lots

routes.shortName: LAX / Metro Transit Center -  SoFi Stadium Express
routes.longName: The express shuttle will operate between the Metro LAX / Metro Transit Center and SoFi Stadium. Shuttle service will run every 5 minutes beginning roughly 3 hours before the event begins and ending roughly 1.5 hours after the event concludes. During the event, shuttles will depart SoFi to the LAX / Metro Transit Center as needed. Metro express service to SoFi Stadium is FREE, but normal fares apply for regular Metro Bus and Rail service and parking fees at Metro Park & Ride lots
